name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar’s Electric Auto (e-Auto) Subsidy Scheme
benefit:
- A subsidy of 75% of the total cost of the electric auto (e-Auto) or ₹3,00,000/- whichever is less will be paid.
- This subsidy is paid after utilizing Central Government incentives under the Pradhan Mantri E-DRIVE Scheme (FAME-3), which provides a maximum subsidy of ₹50,000/-.
- The total cost of the electric auto will be calculated excluding extra accessories.

_eligibility_text: - The applicant should belong to the Union Territory of Puducherry either by virtue of birth or by virtue of continuous residence of not less than 5 years. - The applicant must be of the Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe community recognized by the Union Territory of Puducherry. - The applicant must be a woman. - The total annual income of the applicant and her spouse must not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. - The applicant must be at least 18 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be more than 45 years old on the date of application. - The applicant must not be availing assistance under a prolonged disease. - The applicant must have a valid driving licence for operating the electric auto issued by a Competent Authority. - The applicant must not have availed of a similar subsidy under any other State / Central Scheme for the same purpose. - Only one person per family can avail the benefit once in their lifetime. _*Applicants shall be selected by seniority in age on a first-come-first-served basis._
